webhooks.detail: Webhook subscriptions for plans and sheets (objects: sheet, row, column, cell, comment, discussion, attachment, user.seatType); event patterns like row.created, cell.updated; callbacks to target endpoint

evidence.quote: The webhooks deliver events in callbacks to target endpoints.

sandbox.detail: No free developer sandbox or trial found on developer portal. API restricted to Business and Enterprise plans. Developer tools registration exists for OAuth apps only.

evidence.quote: The Smartsheet API is restricted to users on Business and Enterprise plans.

rate_limits.summary: 300 requests/min per API token; 30/min for file attachment posts and cell history (10x multiplier); HTTP 429 on exceed

evidence.quote: The general limit for most API requests is 300 requests per minute per API token.
